scan_source: first original-inclusive fast_scan report; 363 Wave2 direct definitions + 1014 original definitions and 5 variants; candidates ordered by (-occurrences,phrase)
scope: Original ranks 1–100 reviewed directly against the unchanged 2,019-candidate scan
conventions: Quick source-grounded decisions: new meanings inserted in post_wave2/terms.json; synonymous/existing senses mapped rather than duplicated; genuine ambiguities remain explicitly flagged; grammatical fragments rejected. No new-term search or dependency graph.
